title: An empty-data export still generates: zeroed Summary PDF totals, header-strip-only Expanded PDF, header-row-only CSVs
custom_preconds: 1. The current filter set matches ZERO invoices (for example, a date range with no activity) — the report shows its empty state.
custom_steps:
1. Download all four files from the ⋯ menu.
2. Open each and inspect its contents.
custom_expected:
1. All four downloads produce a FILE, not an error.
2. The Summary PDF renders the header strip, no data rows, and a grand-totals row showing zeros for the money and Inv. Hrs columns and "—" for Margin %.
3. The Expanded View PDF renders just the header strip with no per-rep blocks (it has no grand-totals row).
4. Both CSVs generate a header-row-only file, still starting with the UTF-8 BOM.
5. No special "empty" treatment or message appears inside the files.
